personas.name: Donor
personas.short_description: Restaurant staff who post surplus edible food, complete the handling checklist and track each donation's status.
key_responsibilities: Post a repeat donation with one tap
Speak or type a food description, portions and pickup-by time
Complete a fresh handling checklist covering preparation time, storage and allergens
Publish a donation and track its status
Post manually when voice or AI is unavailable

personas.name: NGO
personas.short_description: Charity or food-relief staff who see nearby eligible donations, claim portions they can use and confirm what arrived.
key_responsibilities: See eligible nearby donations with concise match explanations and in-app alerts
Maintain current need, capacity and availability
Claim all or part of a donation within a short confirmation window

personas.name: Volunteer / NGO Transporter
personas.short_description: Person who goes to a donor to collect claimed food and hands it to the receiving NGO, toggling availability as they go.

personas.name: Admin
personas.short_description: Platform operator who approves or suspends participants, watches active rescues and resolves failed assignments.

personas.name: CSR Sponsor
personas.short_description: Corporate sponsor who reviews campaign recognition and a transparent dashboard of confirmed food rescue impact.
key_responsibilities: View a transparent dashboard of confirmed portions delivered, estimated waste avoided and illustrative costs
